_purpose: Gate G-D documented warning acceptance. Every entry was individually audited; see reasons. Regenerate ONLY alongside the code change that justifies it: php bin/check-plugin-check-parity.php --write-accepted-warnings

reasons.WordPress.DB.DirectDatabaseQuery.SchemaC: Mandatory DDL: activation, migration, uninstall and index-retirement code must CREATE/ALTER/DROP the plugin's own tables; WordPress ships no API for that.
reasons.WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Rec: Read-only $_GET reads (list filters, pagination, tab state) that mutate nothing; each occurrence audited in the 2026-08 T8/T9 rounds, zero suppressions added.
reasons.PluginCheck.Security.DirectDB.UnescapedD: The Customers list splices CustomerIdentity::sql_is_customer() into its three statements so the screen shows customers rather than every account on the site. That fragment is itself one $wpdb->prepare() call with every dynamic value bound, and it carries no caller input -- but WordPress offers no placeholder for composing one prepared statement into another, so the composition is what the sniff reports. Filtering in PHP instead was rejected: it would break LIMIT/OFFSET and the reported total. Added 2026-08-16 with finding M-02.
